question: How do the wise remember the mantra addressed to the child-bodied Kṛṣṇa?
premises: The mantra ends with the head syllable
It is addressed to the child-bodied Kṛṣṇa
It includes the syllable klīṃ and the name Kṛṣṇa
inference: The wise remember the mantra as ending with the head syllable and addressed to child-bodied Kṛṣṇa as 'klīṃ kṛṣṇāya'.
plain_english: The wise remember the mantra, ending with the head syllable, as 'klīṃ kṛṣṇāya' to the child-bodied one.
